summary: Verified /api/pinky/auth endpoint (text/voice modes) returns graceful 401 with ElevenLabs 'missing convai_write permission' message, and confirmed the widget's frontend falls back to plain agentId auth on 401. Voice-mode overrides.agent.firstMessage wiring confirmed via code review. All 5 backend pytest cases pass; frontend integration observed via live network + console capture.
verified_behaviors: GET /api/pinky/auth?mode=text -> 401 {"detail":"The API key you used is missing the permission convai_write to execute this operation."} (propagated from ElevenLabs)
GET /api/pinky/auth?mode=invalid -> 422 validation error (Pydantic regex on Query param)
Frontend text send: network shows GET /api/pinky/auth?mode=text -> 401, console warns '[pinky] /pinky/auth returned 401 - falling back to agentId auth', session still proceeds via agentId

Frontend voice click: network shows GET /api/pinky/auth?mode=voice -> 401, same fallback warning, followed by SDK direct call to https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/conversation/token?agent_id=... confirming agentId fallback path
agent.config.js exports VOICE_FIRST_MESSAGE = "Hi, I'm Pinky, Preeti's portfolio twin..."
AgentPanel.jsx connect effect (lines 77-81) attaches overrides: { agent: { firstMessage: VOICE_FIRST_MESSAGE } } ONLY when sessionMode === 'voice'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined AFTER `app.include_router(api_router)` and after the endpoint definitions. It works at request-time (module-level init completes before requests) but is fragile; move logging config to top of file for clarity.
server.py: endpoint uses synchronous `requests.get(...)` inside a non-async handler; fine for now, but under load consider `httpx.AsyncClient` with an async handler to avoid blocking the event loop.
server.py: on-shutdown handler uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider lifespan handler.
Frontend AgentPanel: the connect effect fetches auth even on repeated mode toggles; no caching. Acceptable for now given very cheap endpoint; note for future optimization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Widget uses data-testid: pinky-floating-button, pinky-text-input, pinky-send-button, pinky-voice-toggle, pinky-mic-button, pinky-stop-button. Backend /api/pinky/auth returns 401 until user regenerates ELEVENLABS_API_KEY with convai_write scope; when they do, endpoint should return 200 with signed_url (text) or conversation_token (voice) and frontend will use those instead of falling back. Voice mode shows 'Connection error' UI banner because LiveKit rejects unauthenticated agent connections — this is expected until convai_write is granted and is explicitly out of scope per the review request.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. The 401 from ElevenLabs is the expected, documented behavior for the current API key scope; the backend surfaces a clean JSON error and the frontend's fallback is exercised correctly.
